docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Whitman's poems of the self, the body, democracy and the open road.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Walt Whitman (1819–1892), Leaves of Grass, the edition of 1891–1892. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
